description: Get the price and payment link for one member note from Cestrian Capital Research, without a membership. This tool takes no money itself: it returns a link. An agent with a payment wallet POSTs to the link and pays the HTTP 402 challenge (Machine Payments Protocol: card through a Stripe Shared Payment Token, or USDC stablecoin) to receive the full note; a person opens the link in a browser to pay. Ask the user before spending their money.

url.description: The note's URL on cestriancapitalresearch.com, or its slug.

name: buy_note
title: Buy one Cestrian research note
